chunks: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad narrated from Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Hammam ibn Suhayl, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik al-Fazari, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Abzari, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him): In which month do we visit al-Husayn (peace be upon him)? He said: 'In the middle of Rajab and the middle of Sha'ban.'

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (the title of the eighth Imam, Ali ibn Musa)
key_terms.رَجَبٍ: Rajab (the seventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar)
key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar)
key_terms.نَزُورُ: We visit (specifically visiting the shrine of an Imam or saint)

ai.seo_question: When is the best time to visit Imam Husayn according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Bazanti inquires with Imam al-Rida (AS) about the optimal timing for visiting the shrine of Imam al-Husayn (AS). The Imam designates the midpoints of Rajab and Sha'ban as the most virtuous times for this pilgrimage, highlighting the spiritual significance of these lunar phases in Shia devotional practice. This specific timing underscores the continuity of reverence for the Ahl al-Bayt throughout the Islamic calendar, linking the month of Rajab (associated with the Prophet's Mi'raj and Imam Ali's birth) and Sha'ban (the month of Imam al-Hasan's birth) to the legacy of Imam al-Husayn.
